subject: can i modify source code after deploying shiny application?

messages.author: 62a25a90e3004e36
messages.subject: can i modify source code after deploying shiny application?
parts: Suppose I already published a Shiny Application some days ago and now I want to modify the source code so that it will reflect on the published app also. Am I able to do that? If not, is there any alternatives?

messages.author: ad8f163f48ed9d1e
messages.subject: Re: can i modify source code after deploying shiny application?
parts:
well, you can simply overwrite the code manually (and dependent data if they exist), but that's not really a good practice ;-) 
it mostly depends on how you deploy your app and how a possible error will impact on users. Is it for fun/learning or a business environment? is it dev or prod?  is it a cloud service like rconnect or your own vps? and so on...

hope this helps
Luca
